inlineSql: Select * From USER_SET WHERE LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND USER_NAME = ' ? ' AND SUB_MENU = ' ? '
SELECT AC_CITY FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY AC_CITY ORDER BY AC_CITY
SELECT AC_AREA FROM AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY AC_AREA ORDER BY AC_AREA
SELECT PACKET_NO FROM DHRN_ISU_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY PACKET_NO ORDER BY PACKET_NO

UPDATE A SET A.DHRN_REC_AMT = B.DhrnRec, A.UNCHAK_DHRN_REC = B.UnchakRec FROM DHRN_ISU_DATA AS A INNER JOIN(Select CO_CODE, ISU_LC, ISU_YRCD, ISU_DBCD, ISU_NO, SUM(DHRN_REC_AMT) As DhrnRec, SUM(UNCHAK_DHRN_REC) As UnchakRec FROM DHRN_DATA GROUP BY CO_CODE, ISU_LC, ISU_YRCD, ISU_DBCD, ISU_NO) As B On A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.LC_CODE = B.ISU_LC And A.CO_YEAR = B.ISU_YRCD And A.CO_BOOK = B.ISU_DBCD And A.VCH_NO = B.ISU_NO And A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? '
DELETE FROM DHRN_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_BOOK = '999'
Select * From AC_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND AC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,A.AC_AREA As AreaL,A.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,A.AC_CITY As CityL,A.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY A.LC_CODE,A.AC_NAME

SELECT C.AC_NAME As AcNameL,C.AC_CODE As AcCodeL,D.AC_GR_NAME AS GroupL,C.AC_AREA As AreaL,C.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,C.AC_CITY As CityL,C.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS C LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS D ON C.CO_CODE = D.CO_CODE AND C.AC_GR = D.AC_GR WHERE C.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(C.AC_CODE AS INT) < 100 UNION ALL SELECT A.AC_NAME,A.AC_CODE,B.AC_GR_NAME,A.AC_AREA,A.AC_ADD1,A.AC_CITY,A.AC_MOBILE FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_GROUP AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_GR = B.AC_GR WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CAST(A.AC_CODE AS INT) >=200 ORDER BY C.AC_NAME
Select * From LOCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? '
Select LC_CODE As CodeL,LC_NAME As NameL,LC_ADD1 As AddressL,LC_CITY As CityL FROM LOCT_MAST WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' ORDER BY LC_CODE

Select B.AC_NAME,A.AC_REF_CODE From AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.AC_REF_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_REF_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT B.AC_NAME As AcNameL,A.AC_REF_CODE As AcCodeL,B.AC_CITY AS CityL,B.AC_ADD1 As AddressL,B.AC_MOBILE As MobileL FROM AC_MAST AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.AC_REF_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_REF_CODE <> '' GROUP BY B.AC_NAME,A.AC_REF_CODE,B.AC_CITY,B.AC_ADD1,B.AC_MOBILE ORDER BY B.AC_NAME
SELECT * FROM DHRN_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.DHRN_AMT,A.VCH_DATE,A.AC_CODE,SUM(B.DHRN_REC_AMT) As DhrnRec,SUM(B.INT_AMT) As IntAmt,SUM(B.INT_REC_AMT) As IntRec,A.LOAN_TYPE FROM DHRN_ISU_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN DHRN_DATA AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = B.LC_CODE AND A.CO_YEAR = B.ISU_YRCD AND A.CO_BOOK = B.ISU_DBCD AND A.VCH_NO = B.ISU_NO WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.ENTRY_TYPE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO,A.DHRN_AMT,A.VCH_DATE,A.AC_CODE,A.LOAN_TYPE HAVING SUM(B.DHRN_REC_AMT) <> 0 ORDER BY A.CO_YEAR,A.CO_BOOK,A.VCH_NO
SELECT VCH_DATE FROM DHRN_REC_DATA WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND ISU_YRCD = ' ? CO_YEAR ? ' AND ISU_DBCD = ' ? CO_BOOK ? ' AND ISU_NO = ' ? VCH_NO ? ' ORDER BY VCH_DATE DESC

INSERT INTO DHRN_DATA(CO_CODE,LC_CODE,CO_YEAR,CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,SR_NO,VCH_DATE,AC_CODE,DHRN_AMT,DHRN_REC_AMT,INT_AMT,INT_REC_AMT,REC_DATE,LOAN_TYPE) VALUES(' ? ',' ? ',' ? CO_YEAR ? ','999',' ? VCH_NO ? ', ? ,' ? VCH_DATE ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ', ? ' ? AC_CODE ? ', ? DHRN_AMT ? , ? DhrnRec ? , ? IntAmt ? , ? IntRec ? ,' ? MM/dd/yyyy ? ',' ? LOAN_TYPE ? ')
UPDATE DHRN_ISU_DATA SET DHRN_REC_AMT = 0 WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? '

SELECT A.CO_CODE,A.ISU_YRCD,A.ISU_DBCD,A.ISU_NO ,SUM(A.DHRN_REC_AMT) AS DhrnRec FROM DHRN_DATA AS A WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' GROUP BY A.CO_CODE,A.ISU_YRCD,A.ISU_DBCD,A.ISU_NO ORDER BY A.CO_CODE,A.ISU_YRCD,A.ISU_DBCD,A.ISU_NO
UPDATE DHRN_ISU_DATA SET DHRN_REC_AMT = DHRN_REC_AMT + ? DhrnRec ? WHERE CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND CO_YEAR = ' ? ISU_YRCD ? ' AND CO_BOOK = ' ? ISU_DBCD ? ' AND VCH_NO = ' ? ISU_NO ? '

SELECT A.DHRN_BILL As RefNoL,replace(convert(NVARCHAR,A.VCH_DATE, 103), ' ', '/') AS VchDateL,A.VCH_NO As VchNoL,B.AC_NAME As PartyNameL,A.AC_NAME As VchNameL FROM DHRN_ISU_DATA AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' and A.DHRN_BILL <> '' AND A.ENTRY_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY A.DHRN_BILL,A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO,B.AC_NAME,A.AC_NAME ORDER BY A.VCH_DATE,A.VCH_NO

SELECT A.CUST_NAME As CustNameL,A.PACKET_NO As PacketNoL,B.AC_NAME As PartyNameL,A.VCH_NO As LoanNoL FROM DHRN_ISU_DETL AS A LEFT JOIN AC_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE AND A.AC_CODE = B.AC_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.ENTRY_TYPE = 'L' GROUP BY A.CUST_NAME,A.PACKET_NO,B.AC_NAME,A.VCH_NO ORDER BY A.CUST_NAME,B.AC_NAME
